notes: HIPE selection uses minimum complete-three-seed mean within a single fixed sigma/layer configuration. Sample SD uses ddof=1.
The two incomplete configs remain visible and are excluded from selection and complete-control improvement counts.
The C4 60M L1024 H1 sigma300 incomplete config is among 16 new layouts without an exact100M control; only C4 20M L2048 H4 sigma700 is among the 72 exact100M-control configs.
All methods within a setting share actual token exposures. WikiText exposures at L1024/L2048 fall slightly below nominal due to partial microbatches.
100M controls have their own full-budget cosine schedule. Comparing controls with longer fresh training changes both exposure and learning-rate trajectory.
verification.shortfall_explanation: After n train chunks, an epoch tail microbatch has n % micro_batch samples. The next microbatch starts a new epoch, so each tail reduces the fixed-accumulation optimizer-step exposure. WikiText L1024 has114847 chunks (one tail); L2048 has56997 chunks (three tails). At L2048 micro16 loses3x11=33 samples; micro8/micro4 lose3x3=9. C4 remains within its first epoch.
